{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    sep = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if v != 0 and sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) > n)
    # separator lines determine panel dimensions
    hr = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row))
    vc = next(i for i in range(n) if all(grid[r][i] == sep for r in range(n)))
    size, step = hr, hr + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # find non-separator design occupying a panel; it provides a binary stencil
    stencil = None
    for r0 in range(0,n,step):
        for c0 in range(0,n,step):
            if r0+size>n or c0+size>n: continue
            vals = {grid[r0+r][c0+c] for r in range(size) for c in range(size)} - {0,sep}
            if vals:
                # exclude colored 2x2 labels in first panel; use design with most cells
                cells = [[grid[r0+r][c0+c] not in (0,sep) for c in range(size)] for r in range(size)]
                if sum(map(sum,cells)) > 4: stencil = cells
    if stencil is None: return out
    # Every horizontal group is labeled by its solid 2x2 marker; draw the stencil
    # in each panel in all columns, using that label's color.
    for r0 in range(0,n,step):
        if r0+size>n: continue
        color = next((grid[r0+r][1] for r in range(size) if grid[r0+r][1] not in (0,sep)), 0)
        if not color: continue
        for c0 in range(0,n,step):
            if c0+size>n: continue
            for r in range(size):
                for c in range(size):
                    out[r0+r][c0+c] = color if stencil[r][c] else 0
    return out
